title: Harden Skill Health Validator
pipeline_rationale: The work changes an existing scheduled validator and filesystem-safety behavior; it needs architecture review, implementation, controlled verification, and handoff, but no application feature code.
summary: Make the daily skill taxonomy validator architecture-aware, safe around junctions, truthful about the historical index, and idempotent.
keyOutcomes: No per-skill junctions are created beneath the Codex parent junction.
Archive cleanup cannot delete junction targets.
Reports, CSV logs, and console output are deterministic and actionable.
risks: Historical global index may intentionally describe lazy-vault skills outside the canonical validation set.
Filesystem reparse-point operations can be destructive if link classification is wrong.
The validator currently runs through an agent prompt, so behavior must be verified non-interactively.
deliverables: Updated latest report/log if the validator is run
validationCriteria: Codex parent junction is never given child junctions
Report, CSV, and console contracts pass
Existing scheduled job remains unique and registry-aligned
